orders.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, store_id INTEGER REFERENCES stores(store_id), customer_id INTEGER REFERENCES customers(customer_id), session_id INTEGER REFERENCES customer_sessions(session_id), order_date TEXT NOT NULL, channel TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(channel IN ('store','online')), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('completed','cancelled','pending')), CHECK((channel='online' AND store_id IS NULL AND session_id IS NOT NULL) OR (channel='store' AND store_id IS NOT NULL AND session_id IS NULL)))
orders.mysqlDDL:
CREATE TABLE orders (
  order_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  store_id BIGINT,
  customer_id BIGINT,
  session_id BIGINT,
  order_date DATE NOT NULL,
  channel VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL CHECK(channel IN ('store','online')),
  status VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('completed','cancelled','pending')),
  CHECK((channel='online' AND store_id IS NULL AND session_id IS NOT NULL) OR (channel='store' AND store_id IS NOT NULL AND session_id IS NULL)),
  FOREIGN KEY (store_id) REFERENCES stores(store_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(customer_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES customer_sessions(session_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin;

order_items.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE order_items (order_item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(order_id), product_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products(product_id), promotion_id INTEGER REFERENCES promotions(promotion_id), quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity>0), unit_price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(unit_price_cents>=0), discount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(discount_cents>=0), unit_cost_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(unit_cost_cents>=0), CHECK(discount_cents<=quantity*unit_price_cents))
order_items.mysqlDDL:
CREATE TABLE order_items (
  order_item_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  product_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  promotion_id BIGINT,
  quantity INT NOT NULL CHECK(quantity>0),
  unit_price_cents BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(unit_price_cents>=0),
  discount_cents BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(discount_cents>=0),
  unit_cost_cents BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(unit_cost_cents>=0),
  CHECK(discount_cents<=quantity*unit_price_cents),
  FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(order_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(product_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES promotions(promotion_id)

CREATE TABLE purchase_order_items (

goods_receipts.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE goods_receipts (receipt_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, po_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES purchase_order_items(po_item_id), receipt_date TEXT NOT NULL, quantity_received INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity_received>0), quantity_rejected INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity_rejected>=0), CHECK(quantity_rejected<=quantity_received))

CREATE TABLE goods_receipts (
  receipt_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,

stock_movements.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE stock_movements (movement_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, warehouse_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses(warehouse_id), product_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products(product_id), movement_date TEXT NOT NULL, movement_type TEXT NOT NULL, quantity_delta INTEGER NOT NULL, unit_cost_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(unit_cost_cents>=0), order_item_id INTEGER REFERENCES order_items(order_item_id), receipt_id INTEGER REFERENCES goods_receipts(receipt_id), CHECK((movement_type IN ('receipt','return') AND quantity_delta>0) OR (movement_type='sale' AND quantity_delta<0)))
stock_movements.mysqlDDL:
CREATE TABLE stock_movements (
  movement_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  warehouse_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  product_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  movement_date DATE NOT NULL,
  movement_type VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
  quantity_delta INT NOT NULL,
  unit_cost_cents BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(unit_cost_cents>=0),
  order_item_id BIGINT,
  receipt_id BIGINT,
  CHECK((movement_type IN ('receipt','return') AND quantity_delta>0) OR (movement_type='sale' AND quantity_delta<0)),
  FOREIGN KEY (warehouse_id) REFERENCES warehouses(warehouse_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(product_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (order_item_id) REFERENCES order_items(order_item_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (receipt_id) REFERENCES goods_receipts(receipt_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin;

views.v_po_lines: CREATE VIEW v_po_lines AS SELECT i.po_item_id,i.po_id,p.supplier_id,p.warehouse_id,p.order_date,p.promised_date,i.product_id,i.quantity_ordered,i.unit_price_cents,i.quantity_ordered*i.unit_price_cents AS ordered_cents,COALESCE(r.received,0) received,COALESCE(r.accepted,0) accepted,COALESCE(r.on_time,0) on_time,COALESCE(b.billed,0) billed,COALESCE(b.billed_cents,0) billed_cents FROM purchase_order_items i JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.po_id=i.po_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT g.po_item_id,SUM(g.quantity_received) received,SUM(g.quantity_received-g.quantity_rejected) accepted,SUM(CASE WHEN g.receipt_date<=p.promised_date THEN g.quantity_received-g.quantity_rejected ELSE 0 END) on_time FROM goods_receipts g JOIN purchase_order_items i ON i.po_item_id=g.po_item_id JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.po_id=i.po_id WHERE g.receipt_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY g.po_item_id) r ON r.po_item_id=i.po_item_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT po_item_id,SUM(quantity_billed) billed,SUM(quantity_billed*unit_price_cents) billed_cents FROM supplier_invoice_items GROUP BY po_item_id) b ON b.po_item_id=i.po_item_id WHERE p.status<>'cancelled'
